---
title: "__TITLE__"
subtitle: "__SUBTITLE__"
date: "__DATE__"
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    classoption:
      - 11pt
      - a4paper
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    geometry:
      - margin=2.5cm
      - top=3.5cm
      - bottom=2.6cm
      - headheight=2.0cm
      - headsep=0.8cm
    mainfont: "Helvetica Neue"
    mainfontoptions:
      - Ligatures=TeX
    monofont: "Menlo"
    monofontoptions:
      - Scale=0.92
    number-sections: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    colorlinks: true
    keep-tex: false
    include-in-header:
      # All brand mechanics live in brand.sty: the accent colour, the callout
      # boxes, the section divider, the cover and closing pages, the header and
      # footer and the mandatory titlesec fix. Edit brand.sty to rebrand.
      - file: brand.sty
      - text: |
          % --- Per-document wiring -------------------------------------
          % The graphicspath points at the folder holding the logo files.
          % Set the correct number of ../ segments from this .qmd to that
          % folder. A wrong depth makes the logo fail to load.
          \graphicspath{{__GRAPHICSPATH__}{images/}}

          % Footer tagline shown on every content page (under 60 chars).
          \renewcommand{\brandFooterTagline}{__FOOTER_TAGLINE__}

          % Name shown in the cover footer line.
          \renewcommand{\brandCoverFooterName}{__COVER_FOOTER_NAME__}

    include-before-body:
      text: |
        \brandcover
          {__COVER_LABEL__}
          {__COVER_TITLE__}
          {__COVER_RECIPIENT__}
          {__COVER_DATE__}

    include-after-body:
      text: |
        \brandclose
          {__CLOSE_LINE_1__}
          {__CLOSE_LINE_2__}
---

__BODY__
